name: Audit workspace sync fence predicate and adapter failure cleanup
description: Investigate and fix the workspace sync fence predicate in the control-plane spine. The current predicate if (event.workspace !== workspaceID && event.payload.type !== "sync") appears to use && where || may be intended — an event from the wrong workspace with payload type "sync" could fall through to synced(state). Also add cleanup of persisted workspace rows if adapter creation fails after DB insert, and review transactional behavior around workspace creation.
